articles.title: Judge denies xAI’s request to block Minnesota ban on ‘nudify’ apps
articles.summary: Despite a lawsuit from xAI, a Minnesota ban on apps that allow users to “nudify” images can move forward.

articles.title: YouTuber Hank Green says his AI usage is ‘not healthy’
articles.summary: Green offered a remarkable apology, saying that "the level of dopamine that I've been getting from interacting with LLMs ... is not healthy for me or good for the world."

articles.title: Google nixes its Earth AI feature one day after launch, amid criticism it would spread misinformation
articles.summary: A tool that allowed anyone to generate fake AI-generated imagery and superimpose it over real Google Earth maps quickly spurred backlash.

articles.title: Sam Altman isn’t the only one who wants to pump the brakes on AI
articles.summary: After years of pushing full speed ahead on AI, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says maybe it’s time for the AI industry to “pace” itself. The comments came just days after one of OpenAI’s own models broke out of its test environment and got tangled up in a breach at Hugging Face — though as Equity’s hosts point out, sloppy security seems to have […]

articles.title: Google Earth’s AI deepfake tool only lasted one day
articles.summary: Google has shut down Google Earth feature it launched Thursday that allowed users to edit satellite images with text prompts using AI. The tool essentially let users create AI deepfakes of the real world using text prompts; Digital Digging's Henk van Ess, for example, intentionally generated images adding things like refugees near the Mexican border […]
